company_name: China State Construction International Holdings Limited
model: Levered FCFE DCF at cost of equity, SOE borrowings treated as operating funding (engine route)

equity_bridge.note: H1 2026 interim balance sheet line 977; USD500m sub perp redeemed and RMB2.0bn issued in H1 2026
H1 2026 interim balance sheet line 978; flows are consolidated so NCI charged here once

historical_growth.growth_rate_source: judgment: revenue 3yr CAGR (3.4%) and the FY2026 reset; equity CAGR (11%) overstates because retained earnings were reinvested in project receivables with near-zero FCFE
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity CAGR 11.0-11.2% diverges >30% from revenue 3yr CAGR 3.4% and EPS 3yr 5.2%: book grew by retaining earnings into investment receivables and by the 2025 placement, not by cash generation. FCF CAGRs are undefined: owner FCF (FCFE) was negative in FY2020 (-HK$5,080m) and FY2022 (-HK$151m) against +RMB84m in FY2025; SBC is nil throughout so there is no SBC-vs-reported gap.
historical_growth.notes: FY2018-FY2023 rows in the Metrics.csv are HKD, FY2024+ are RMB (restated). CAGRs computed in RMB with FY2020 HKD figures x 0.8424 and FY2022 x 0.891 (year-end HKD/CNY). Revenue: RMB52.6bn (FY2020) -> 90.9bn (FY2022) -> 100.4bn (FY2025). EPS: RMB1.00 -> 1.41 -> 1.64. Equity: RMB41.4bn -> 51.5bn -> 70.4bn (FY2025 includes RMB2.8bn placement).

scenario_narratives.base: The H1 2026 cash-conversion turn is real but only partly durable. Revenue resets ~10% in FY2026 (Macau lull, mainland project timing) then recovers at 3-4% on the Northern Metropolis pipeline, I-PARK2, the Tsing Yi BOT and mainland MiC urban renewal. The mainland investment book shifts to shorter-payback government-repurchase projects, so net project outlay settles near 3% of revenue (4% all-in with PP&E) rather than the 7-8% of FY2023-25: FCFE of roughly RMB4.5bn in FY2026 covers the ~RMB2.8bn dividend and ~RMB0.3bn of perp distributions for the first time, and gearing drifts down as guided. Levered margin holds ~13% as cheaper RMB funding (1.5-1.8% MTNs) offsets mix drift to low-margin HK contracting. Terminal value binds at the 12x FCFE cap.
scenario_narratives.bull: The H1 2026 profile is the new normal: mainland cash collection stays above 100%, factoring of local-government receivables winds down, and net project outlay runs at ~2% of revenue. Gross margin holds near 18% as MiC and technology-driven contracts (RMB85bn signed FY2025) carry premium pricing, financing cost keeps falling with 10-year RMB MTNs, and revenue regrows 5-7% from FY2027 as Northern Metropolis, Macau's Four Major Projects and the first HK BOT project ramp together. FCFE compounds to ~RMB11bn by FY2035 and the stock re-rates from 4x to a normal contractor's 9-10x earnings; the model's 12x FCFE cap still binds.
scenario_narratives.bear: Local-government fiscal stress (the 2023-27 debt restructuring window) slows repurchase and buy-back payments, so the group keeps sinking 6-7% of revenue into receivables and leans on connected-party factoring at 93-95 cents; receivable impairments and a soft property cycle at the associates pull the levered margin to 11%. Revenue falls 15% in FY2026 and again in FY2027 as Macau mega-projects do not recur and HK private development stays weak, then grows ~2%. FCFE of ~RMB2bn/yr does not cover the dividend, so the payout is debt- and perp-funded as it was in FY2023-25, gearing stops falling, and equity value is a small residual behind RMB91bn of borrowings. Terminal value binds at the 12x cap on a thin FCFE.

valuation_philosophy.summary: CSCI is priced as a leveraged SOE financing vehicle (4.3x P/E, 0.5x book, 7.6% yield) rather than as a contractor, because for a decade its earnings were reinvested in mainland project receivables and the dividend was funded by borrowings and perpetuals. The valuation therefore turns on one line -- how much of each revenue dollar keeps going into the investment book -- and the three scenarios bracket that line from the FY2023-25 history (bear) to the H1 2026 print (bull). Debt is treated as operating funding and the equity is valued on levered FCFE at a 10.5% RMB cost of equity; intrinsic values are converted to HKD at CNY/HKD 1.1745 so they are comparable to the quote.
key_risks_to_valuation: Project-investment outlay path: each 1pp of revenue sunk into receivables is ~RMB1bn/yr of FCFE, roughly RMB2/share (HK$2.3) of value at the cost of equity
Local-government payment delays or receivable impairments on the RMB100bn+ mainland investment book (factoring already at 93-95 cents)
Cost of equity: 64.5% net gearing makes equity value highly sensitive to the discount rate -- see the required-return table
Refinancing/interest-rate reversal on RMB85-91bn of borrowings (20% HKD-denominated at HIBOR); a 50bp rise is ~RMB0.45bn/yr of FCFE
Revenue lumpiness: Macau fell 58% in FY2025 and H1 2026 group revenue fell 22.5%; the FY2026 reset could be deeper
CNY/HKD translation: a 5% RMB depreciation lowers every HKD per-share value by 5%
Perpetual capital securities and NCI are deducted at book; a further perp issue to fund the dividend transfers value from ordinary holders

data_sources.price: Yahoo Finance chart API at inputs.price_as_of (HKEX intraday); 52-week range 6.92-10.25 HKD
data_sources.fx: Yahoo Finance CNYHKD=X at 2026-10-22T07:48Z, cross-checked against USDCNY=X and USDHKD=X
data_sources.financials: 3311.HK_Metrics.csv (FY2018-FY2025, H1 2024-H1 2026; HKD through FY2023, RMB from FY2024) and kpis; FY2025 Annual Report and H1 2026 Interim Report text in Extracted/ for the bridge items, borrowings maturity table, cash flow lines and share count
data_sources.qualitative: 3311.HK_Analysis.json (business model, segment mix, guidance, bull/bear axes)

inputs.net_borrowings_note: Company-defined net borrowings RMB53,256m at 2026-06-30 (total borrowings RMB91,128m: bank 76,947 + USD guaranteed notes 1,688 + RMB corporate bonds 12,493; less cash RMB37,720m); net gearing 64.5%. Held at ZERO in the model because the flows are LEVERED (after net finance cost) and discounted at cost of equity -- deducting the borrowings again would double-charge the debt. The Metrics.csv total_debt (RMB92,006m) additionally includes loans from fellow subsidiaries/JVs.
inputs.sbc_source: FY2025 AR consolidated cash flow statement (line 6021): share-based payment nil in FY2025, RMB6.8m FY2024, RMB7.4m FY2023 restated -- SBC-zero market; equity-award taxes nil
inputs.fx_note: Statements and flows in RMB (presentation currency changed from HKD to RMB with the 2025 interim; FY2024 onward in the CSV is RMB on restated comparatives, FY2018-FY2023 remain HKD). Quote in HKD on HKEX. fx_rate is CNY->HKD = 1.1745 (Yahoo CNYHKD=X, 2026-10-22T07:48Z); parity check via USD crosses USDHKD 7.8408 / USDCNY 6.6728 = 1.1750 (0.04% tie) and HKDCNY=X 0.8505 -> 1/0.8505 = 1.1758. Direction: multiply RMB per-share values by 1.1745 to get HKD. No A-share or dual listing exists for a price parity check. Dividends are declared in HK cents (FY2025 total HK62.5c; H1 2026 interim HK33c).
inputs.price_as_of: 2026-10-22T07:32:52Z (HKEX intraday print, 15:32 HKT, ~30 min before the close; replace at the regular close)
inputs.share_count_basis: 5,282.217m weighted average ordinary shares for basic AND diluted EPS, H1 2026 interim note (line 1853); diluted equals basic (no dilutive instruments outstanding). Count was 5,037.6m until the March 2025 Orient International placement (RMB2,798m net proceeds). Held flat: SBC is nil and the placement is already in the count.
inputs.wacc_rationale: Cost of equity, not WACC, because the flows are levered FCFE. Built in RMB: China 10y CGB ~1.8%, China/HK equity risk premium ~6.5%, beta ~1.2 for a 64%-geared SOE contractor with a local-government receivable book gives ~9.6%; rounded up to 10.5% to sit with the house RMB cost of equity for Chinese SOE financial-type names (0998.HK 10.5%, 2016.HK 11.0%). Same rate in all three scenarios -- cash-conversion and receivable risk is carried in the scenario paths and weights, not in per-scenario discount rates. Note the company's own value-in-use discount rate is 9.6% (FY2025 AR line 9415).
inputs.lease_treatment: (B) leases as operating cost: lease principal (RMB208.5m FY2025, CF line 6106) plus lease interest (RMB11.0m, line 8405) = RMB219.5m = 0.22% of revenue charged inside the flows via lease_cost_pct_path; lease liabilities (RMB309m at 2026-06-30) excluded from the bridge. D&A path is ex right-of-use depreciation to the extent disclosed (immaterial at this scale).
inputs.nci_treatment: Flows are CONSOLIDATED (FY0 NOPAT ties to NetIncomeInclNCI RMB9,005m: PBT 11,967.5 x (1-0.25) = 8,976); the NCI book value RMB3,741.7m at 2026-06-30 (CSC Development 830.HK minority and project NCIs) is deducted once in the equity bridge. Perpetual capital securities RMB5,570.0m at 2026-06-30 (equity-classified, distributions RMB334m FY2025 sit outside finance costs) are debt-like and deducted in the bridge as well.
inputs.jv_associate_treatment: Share of profits of JVs/associates (RMB846m FY2025, RMB298m H1 2026) is RETAINED inside the levered EBITDA margin, so the RMB15,647m JV and RMB5,407m associate carrying values (2026-06-30) are NOT added to the bridge -- rule 7(d) satisfied in the keep-income direction. Adding RMB21bn of mainland property/project JV book value at par would be worth ~HK$4.7/share and is not something the market pays for.
inputs.ebitda_definition: LEVERED: ebitda_margin_path = (profit before tax + D&A) / revenue, i.e. after net finance cost (finance costs RMB2,470m less interest income RMB301m FY2025) and including share of JV/associate profit. Actuals: FY2023 11.4% (HKD), FY2024 12.1%, FY2025 12.8%, H1 2026 14.9% (gross margin 18.6% vs 15.0%, financing cost -0.6pp). Cash tax is applied to this post-interest EBIT, which is the levered convention; interest income is therefore NOT stripped and cash is NOT added.
inputs.capex_definition: capex_pct_path = PP&E capex (~1.0% of revenue: RMB969m FY2025, RMB976m FY2024) PLUS the net cash sunk into construction-investment project receivables/contract assets (BOT/BT, government targeted-repurchase housing, toll roads). That outlay is the capital base of the mainland investment business and is measured as (pre-interest, pre-tax EBITDA ex-JV) minus (OCF + finance costs paid + income taxes paid): FY2023 8.4% of revenue, FY2024 7.2%, FY2025 7.2%, H1 2025 8.6%, H1 2026 ~1.2%. wc_capture_pct is 0 so that the whole working-capital story lives in this one auditable line.
inputs.notes: MODEL: levered FCFE at RMB cost of equity via the engine route, net_debt = 0 -- the same construction as 1186.HK (CRCC). CSCI straddles two routing rows: 40% of revenue is capital-light HK/Macau contracting, but 53% is a mainland construction-investment business whose assets are multi-year receivables from local governments funded by RMB85-91bn of SOE-cheap borrowings (weighted cost ~2.9%, 2025 MTNs at 1.8%). An unlevered DCF would either charge that debt at an 8-9% WACC the company does not pay or, at the market-weighted ~5.5%, swing the equity value by half on 50bp; with market cap at ~37% of enterprise value neither is stable. Levered FCFE after the actual interest bill, with perps and NCI deducted and borrowings treated as operating funding, is the honest frame and matches how the market prices the name (P/E 4.3x, 7.6% yield). The single dominant judgment is the project-investment outlay path: FY2023-25 the group reinvested ~7-8% of revenue in project receivables so FCFE (RMB84m FY2025) did not cover the ~RMB2.8bn dividend plus ~RMB0.3bn perp distributions; H1 2026 showed record OCF RMB3,796m with outlay ~1.2% of revenue and management states mainland cash collection >100%. Base assumes outlay settles at ~3% (4% all-in with PP&E), bear assumes the FY2023-25 profile persists, bull assumes the H1 2026 profile is the new normal. FY0 is FY2025; FY2026 year-1 growth is set from H1 2026 revenue -22.5% YoY (RMB43.9bn, flat on H2 2025's RMB43.8bn). Trailing-twelve-month FCFE to June 2026 is RMB3,751m (FY2025 84 + H1 2026 3,472 - H1 2025 -195). Historical CAGRs convert the HKD years at year-end HKD/CNY (FY2020 0.8424, FY2022 0.891) because the CSV mixes currencies. Owner FCF = reported FCF: SBC nil, interest income retained (levered model). Band position is null: SBC-zero market, house and street coincide.

base.growth_note: FY2026 -10%: H1 2026 revenue -22.5% YoY on Macau and mainland project timing, H2 assumed flat-to-up on H2 2025. Recovery from FY2027 on Northern Metropolis (>HK$100bn pipeline), I-PARK2 (HK$52.4bn), Tsing Yi BOT and mainland MiC urban renewal, fading to 2.5% nominal RMB.
base.margin_note: Levered (PBT + D&A)/revenue. FY2025 12.8%, H1 2026 14.9% (H2 seasonally lower: FY2025 H1 12.6% PBT margin vs H2 11.0%). Falling RMB financing cost offsets mix drift to lower-margin HK contracting.
base.capex_note: PP&E ~1.0% plus net project-investment outlay settling at ~3% of revenue (2.5% growth on a ~RMB100bn receivable book), versus 7-8% in FY2023-25 and ~1.2% in H1 2026.
base.tax_note: Cash taxes paid / PBT: FY2023 15.6%, FY2024 20.1%, FY2025 27.9%; income tax expense / PBT FY2025 24.8% (PRC 25%, HK 16.5%, plus PRC dividend withholding). 26% on post-interest EBIT.

required_return_table.note: Each row rebuilds the terminal value at that row's rate (max(0, min(Gordon@r, 12x FCF_N))); the WACC row is valuation.base.intrinsic_value and the hurdle row is entry_price.base.entry_price.

sensitivity.note: Rows are WACC, columns terminal growth; each cell rebuilds its own terminal value.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear raised from the 15% default to 30%: 64.5% net gearing, a receivable book that depends on local-government fiscal capacity, evidence of discounted factoring, and only one half-year (H1 2026) of the cash-conversion improvement the base case relies on. Bull cut to 20% because it needs cash conversion, margin and revenue recovery to land together. Base 50%.
probability_weighted.band_note: House and street coincide (SBC immaterial): the band collapsed, so band_position is null rather than a degenerate 0.

sanity_check.basis: SBC-adjusted on both sides (EPS less SBC/share; EBITDA less SBC), so these deliberately do not match GAAP screener multiples.
